comment: Herdr plugins hosted outside this repo. In-repo ones are discovered from plugins/*/herdr-plugin.toml; these are installed by `herdr plugin install <installTarget>`.

plugins.label: Annotate
plugins.description: Annotate terminal selections, review documents and agent replies, and render Mermaid in Pi replies. Needs Bun and pi-loom-mermaid.
plugins.nextAction: Run `herdr server reload-config`, then use your Herdr prefix with `A`, `O`, or `Shift+O`.
